title: Node Sass is end-of-life
summary: Node Sass is no longer maintained and its repository has been archived.

constraints: Preserve Sass include paths, importer behavior, output style, source maps, and generated CSS expected by the build.

steps.title: Replace Node Sass
steps.instructions: Remove node-sass and add the maintained sass package in the same dependency section.

steps.title: Update compiler usages
steps.instructions: Migrate render and renderSync imports and options to the supported Sass interface used by the project.

steps.title: Compare compiled output
steps.instructions: Review generated CSS and source maps for behaviorally relevant differences.

verification.purpose: Run stylesheet and repository tests when defined.
Compile the project and its stylesheets with Sass.
